σάββατον.shortDefinition: a sabbath, Saturday; fig. a week

σέβομαι.shortDefinition: to revere, have piety; fig. to worship

σκανδαλίζω.shortDefinition: to trip up; fig. to offend, scandalize

σκάνδαλον.shortDefinition: a stumbling block; fig. an offensive thing, scandal

σκεῦος.shortDefinition: a vessel, container; fig. a thing

σκηνόω.shortDefinition: to tabernacle, encamp; fig. to dwell

σκοπός.shortDefinition: a scope, domain; fig. a goal

σκύβαλον.shortDefinition: what’s thrown to the dogs; fig. garbage

σπένδω.shortDefinition: to pour out as an offering

στρώννυμι.shortDefinition: to spread; fig. to arrange, straighten up

συνέρχομαι.shortDefinition: to come together, accompany; fig. to consummate

σχολή.shortDefinition: a vacancy, abandonment; fig. a school
